scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml packages/ui/node_modules packages/docs/node_modules packages/app-extension/node_modules packages/app-extension/dist packages/docs/.quasar packages/docs/dist
scripts.build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:app-ext && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.api:generate: pnpm --dir packages/docs exec qpress api generate --root ../..
scripts.api:check: pnpm --dir packages/docs exec qpress api check --root ../..
scripts.check:qpress: pnpm --dir packages/docs exec qpress check --root ../.. --src-dir packages/docs/src
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch dev && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch dev
scripts.ci:publish:latest: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch dev --tag latest && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch dev --tag latest
scripts.ci:publish:beta: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qmediaplayer publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.verify:build: pnpm build && pnpm api:check && pnpm check:qpress && pnpm typecheck
